title: Prompt Vault — AI Integration and MCP Reference
purpose: Details on AI provider configuration, streaming, and MCP server integration.

ai_providers.overview: The app supports Ollama (local) and three cloud providers. Provider and model are configured in Settings and stored in localStorage.

ollama.notes: Must be running locally on the user's machine. No API key needed. Best for privacy.

openai.notes: Standard OpenAI API. GPT-4, GPT-4o, etc.

ai_providers.configuration_storage: All provider config (provider name, model, API keys) lives in localStorage. Not persisted to DB.
ai_providers.chat_persistence: Chat history is session-only. Refreshing the page clears it. This is by design.

ai_chat_flow.request: POST /api/ai/chat with { messages: Message[], provider: string, model: string }
ai_chat_flow.response: Streaming text — the server streams tokens back as they are generated
ai_chat_flow.frontend: client/src/pages/assistant.tsx handles the stream and appends to local message state
ai_chat_flow.no_tools: The base AI chat does not have tool use. MCP tools are separate (see below).

mcp_integration.protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — JSON-RPC over HTTP
mcp_integration.purpose: Allows users to connect external tool servers that extend AI capabilities
operations: Add a new MCP server by name and URL
Discover tools available on a specific server
mcp_integration.notes: Tools discovered from MCP servers are listed but not automatically injected into chat. This is a display/management feature.

model_listing.returns: Available models per provider. For Ollama, queries the local server. For cloud providers, returns a curated list.

troubleshooting.ollama_not_responding: Verify Ollama is running: open terminal and run 'ollama list'. Default URL is http://localhost:11434.
troubleshooting.cloud_key_error: Check that the correct API key is set in Settings. Keys are stored in localStorage — inspect it in browser DevTools.
troubleshooting.stream_drops: Network interruptions can break streaming. The frontend should handle partial streams gracefully.
troubleshooting.wrong_model: Models list is loaded from GET /api/ai/models. If a model is missing, check server/ai-provider.ts model list.
